topic: What happens if you drink ten cups of coffee a day?
title: What too much coffee does
hook: What happens if you drink ten cups of coffee?

beats.label: 1 CUP
beats.line: One cup. Caffeine blocks the chemical that makes you sleepy.

beats.label: 4 CUPS
beats.line: Four cups is about the most experts call safe in a day.

beats.label: 6 CUPS
beats.line: Six cups. Your heart speeds up, and your hands start to shake.

beats.label: 8 CUPS
beats.line: Eight cups. Your stomach burns, and you start to feel anxious.

beats.label: 10 CUPS
beats.line: Ten cups. Even when you're exhausted, you can't fall asleep.

end.line: How many cups did you have today?

description: What happens to your brain, heart and sleep as the coffee cups add up.

facts.claim: Caffeine blocks adenosine receptors (adenosine builds sleep pressure).
Up to 400 mg caffeine a day (about 4 cups of brewed coffee) is generally safe for healthy adults.
High intake can cause fast heartbeat, tremor/jitters, upset stomach, anxiety and insomnia.
